summary: This table presents the revenue distribution across different regions for the quarters ending December 31, 2024, September 30, 2024, and December 31, 2023, along with year-over-year (YoY) growth percentages. The regions included are North America, Europe, Rest of the World, and India, with total revenue consistently reported as 100% across the quarters. Notably, North America shows a slight increase from 58.4% in December 2024 to 59.0% in December 2023, while Europe experiences a decline from 29.8% to 28.2%. India exhibits significant growth, with a reported YoY growth of 38.3% in December 2024. The overall YoY growth for the total revenue is reported at 5.9%.
